## Approved pretrained encoder E2 completed — numerical PASS — 2026-11-04

The investigator explicitly instructed continuing in direct response to the exact E2 execution approval question. The unchanged plan SHA-256 is `eb6d30fc31217dee57c9200fcfcff982ebbee0facb12fdeff3b6f9da3b92692b`. The separate authorization records the actual bundle/use, prospective criteria, ten evaluations, one unused legacy 64-value construction noise draw/native initializer work and finite shared-host envelope.

**Both native workers exit 0; the numerical comparison report exits 0.** Five encoder evaluations per implementation complete once: baseline 36, repeat 36, reversed 36, partitions 18+18. There are 32 distinct token rows, 36 baseline occurrences and 144 submitted occurrences per implementation, not 144 independent inputs.

Every raw posterior endpoint and intermediate state passes the prospectively fixed combined band `abs(modern-original) <= 2e-6 + 2e-5*abs(original)`, across all saved cases:

| Field | Maximum absolute difference |
| --- | ---: |
| Mean | 1.9073486328125e-6 |
| Raw log-variance | 3.814697265625e-6 |
| First bidirectional sequence | 2.682209014892578e-7 |
| Final second-layer state | 5.587935447692871e-7 |

Zero elements exceed the combined band. The log-variance maximum passes through the declared relative term; this is not cross-implementation bitwise equality. Within each worker, retained numerical repeats/layout/duplicate values agree exactly. JSON equality does not diagnose signed-zero bit identity.

Each worker deserializes exactly the seventeen encoder arrays and opens 23 distinct selected model files. The legacy audit has 24 open events because its master JSON produces two events through the Python 3.8 Path opener hook; audit-event count is not another parameter/model evaluation. No unrelated scientific asset/PCA, decoder, AMP/MIC classifier, descriptor or Macrel evaluation occurs.

The legacy construction draws exactly one unused eager epsilon vector of shape64, as approved. The actual selected executable, including all function bodies, contains no random operations and retains its graph identity across all five calls. Modern calls preserve both NumPy and Torch RNG state. Native initializer RNG/SVD remains counted within the one construction.

| Supervised worker | Original | Modern |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Wall seconds | 4.641193 | 3.485954 |
| Peak sampled process-tree RSS | 367.45 MiB | 272.75 MiB |

Total supervised time **8.127147 s**; maximum retained run output **41,347,047 bytes**. No resource stop, retry or GPU computation. These single shared-host instrumented observations include startup/output work and do not establish a general speedup.

Same installed dev4 wheel `01fe4e125eca5decdca89f43e8925e8e969d3453b7a4da701be8e96e5e18dbe0`, original/starter assets, installed code/dependencies, accepted dev3 and consumer artifacts remain unchanged. No runtime fix or tolerance widening was needed.

Owner records: `devguide/pytorch_encoder_E2.md`, `devguide/evidence/pytorch_encoder_E2_authorization.json`, `devguide/evidence/pytorch_encoder_E2_execution.json`. Consumer records: `devguide/hydramp_encoder_E2.md`, corresponding authorization/execution evidence. Frozen pre-execution proposal copies preserve the original preparation hashes. All output files, native logs/exits, exact identities and resource observations are retained through 2026-11-14. Consumer: https://github.com/uibcdf/peptidemt/issues/32.

**The ten-evaluation allowance is exhausted.** This is finite pretrained deterministic encoder qualification on structural token controls, not scientific adoption of dev4, arbitrary-input/biological equivalence, uniform superiority, analogue generation or training. Earlier decoder/AMP FAILs remain valid. Keep #8 open for investigator disposition; no new call, #7 filter fix, other family, release, commit/push or original-author contact follows.

## Approved real encoder E2 completed; prospective numerical comparison PASS — 2026-11-04

Owner outcome: https://github.com/uibcdf/hydramp/issues/8#issuecomment-6633776633.

The investigator separately approved exact plan `eb6d30fc31217dee57c9200fcfcff982ebbee0facb12fdeff3b6f9da3b92692b`. Both workers complete five evaluations once; native worker exits and the numerical report are **0**. All mean/raw log-variance and intermediate comparisons pass the prospectively fixed atol=2e-6, rtol=2e-5 combined band on **32 distinct token rows**, including duplicates, repeats, permutation and partitions.

Maximum absolute mean/log-variance differences are **1.90735e-6 / 3.81470e-6**, with zero elements outside the combined band. Retained numeric repeat/layout/duplicate values match exactly within each implementation. This does not assert cross-implementation bitwise identity.

The original constructor's one unused eager 64-value noise draw occurs as authorized; its selected executable excludes random operations. Modern calls preserve NumPy/Torch RNG state. Each worker reads only the selected 23 distinct files / seventeen parameter arrays; no PCA, decoder/predictive heads, descriptors or Macrel call.

Total supervised time is **8.127147 s**, peak sampled process-tree RSS **367.45 MiB**, no GPU computation, retry or resource stop. These are instrumented single shared-host observations, not general performance claims.

Maintained outcome: `devguide/hydramp_encoder_E2.md`; exact approval and execution evidence: `devguide/evidence/hydramp_encoder_E2_authorization.json`, `devguide/evidence/hydramp_encoder_E2_execution.json`. Frozen proposal copies preserve preparation identities; all outputs/logs/exits are retained.

The **ten-evaluation allowance is exhausted**. This supports finite pretrained deterministic encoder fidelity; scientific adoption, arbitrary-input/biological equivalence, analogue generation and training remain separate. The dev4 runtime/wheel, accepted dev3/consumer artifacts, earlier unfavorable evidence, D35/M1–M8 and both selectors remain unchanged. #8/#32 stay open for disposition and future separately commissioned work. No new call, family, publication or original-author contact is authorized by this outcome.
